title: 石桥同意视频职员指南
instruction:
您是为 Stonebridge Agriculture 职业健康诊所提供支持的区域音频和视频技术人员。诊所正在转向由办事员在网络平板电脑上自行录制手术前同意视频，下班后没有 AV 专家在场，纳迪亚·奥伯特 (Nadia Aubert) 需要一个指南，让没有录音背景的办事员在第一晚就可以正确使用。 Magda Danforth 整理了`clinic_consent_recording_pack.xlsx`，其中包含未完成的业务员指南、两期诊所试点结果、Stonebridge Agriculture 和 Ashcombe Energy 的技术验证观察结果，以及经过律师审查的加利福尼亚州和俄勒冈州要求。将这些材料转化为一本可供出版的工作簿，名为 `Stonebridge_clerk_recording_guide.xlsx`。它应该以简单的语言、面向职员的顺序打开，包括房间和平板电脑设置、录音本身、播放检查以及停止和再次录音的明确原因。将技术发现转化为职员无需仪表或专业术语即可执行的操作，但不要以允许无法使用的同意记录的方式简化它们。包括显示准备保留的记录和必须纠正的记录的工作示例，并使加州和俄勒冈州的要求在职员需要时易于区分。
为 Nadia 添加一份简明的批准摘要，比较两个试点期，确定重大变化及其主要原因，并为剩余的推出行动提供具体的所有者和时间安排。计算必须反映源记录而不是明显的电子表格足迹，并且影响报告率的任何判断调用都应该在简短的方法注释中可见。记录您对未完成的指南所做的更改，以便 Gabriel Calderon 可以批准发布版本，而无需比较每个单元格。将患者信息保留在工作簿之外，不要将 Ashcombe Energy 的做法作为 Stonebridge 政策来呈现，并且仅使用所提供材料支持的事实。使用文件名`Stonebridge_clerk_recording_guide.xlsx`将完成的文件写入工作目录的顶层。

---

上述文件位于`references/`中：

- `references/clinic_consent_recording_pack.xlsx` — 提供未完成的指南、两期试点记录、AV 验证结果、批准的加利福尼亚州和俄勒冈州要求、推出责任和发布背景。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `Stonebridge_clerk_recording_guide.xlsx` — 可供出版的职员记录和自检指南，包括工作示例、管辖区特定说明、试点周期比较、方法披露、推出行动和修订记录。 （将工作簿放在工作目录的顶层。；使用准确的文件名Stonebridge_clerk_recording_guide.xlsx。；工作簿必须在面向职员的指南上打开。；仅使用由clinic_consent_recording_pack.xlsx支持的事实。；不要包括患者信息或将 Ashcombe Energy 实践描述为 Stonebridge 农业政策。；使计算判断调用在简明的方法注释中可见。；包括对未完成的指南所做的更改的记录。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

sheets.name: AV validation
rows: Joint field observations — Stonebridge operating requirements are identified separately from comparative observations
A closed, unpropped door; television, pager alerts, and avoidable equipment noise off; pause paper sorting during recording. These controls were required in every successful Stonebridge run.
Landscape orientation on a stable support at approximately eye level was the validated Stonebridge configuration.
Keep the tablet microphone unobstructed. Remove the folding folio cover when its flap lies over the lower microphone edge; it interfered with capture.
Keep the person 58–82 cm from the tablet. Keep required faces in frame and position the person away from a bright window or other backlight.

Whispered answers caused tablet automatic gain to raise room sound and reduced intelligibility. A normal conversational voice was reliable at the validated distance. Manual gain adjustment was not part of the validation.

Set tablet playback to 68%; stand 1.4 m from the device; first-listen the opening identity confirmation and a quieter consent answer. Every word must be understood on the first listen without raising playback to maximum and without pumping, clipping, or room-roar symptoms.

Fresh-record if a required face is out of frame; a jurisdiction-required element is missing; any words are not understood on first listen; or playback has pumping, clipping, or room roar. Correct the condition first, then record the entire interaction again. Do not edit, dub, or splice.

Escalate through the clinic on-call directory to the Consent Support Lead if the tablet will not start, save, or securely upload a complete recording, or if required consent wording is unclear. Do not improvise wording or bypass secure upload.
Ashcombe teams trialed a lapel microphone and portrait capture. This was a comparative observation only and was not validated for Stonebridge Agricultural.
Do not use as Stonebridge policy
A fabric wall panel was considered for a future noise experiment; it was not required or validated for current clinic use.

START HERE  •  Follow the steps in order.  If a required item fails, correct it and make a complete fresh recording — never edit, dub, or splice.
Close the door; do not leave it propped open. Turn off TV, pager alerts, and avoidable equipment noise. Pause paper sorting.
Stop before recording; quiet the room.
Use landscape orientation on a stable support at about eye level.
The tablet must not be hand-held or tilted.
Keep the microphone edge uncovered. Remove the folding folio cover if its flap lies over the lower microphone edge.
Keep the person 58–82 cm (about two to three hand-widths) from the tablet. Keep required faces in frame and face the person away from bright windows or other backlight.
Faces and speech must be reviewable.
Move tablet/person and check framing again.
Start the recording before the opening statement. Speak at a normal conversational level — not a whisper and not a shout.
A whisper can make the tablet lift room noise. Keep the same normal voice at the validated distance.
Do not adjust tablet audio gain.

State clinic, recording date and time, clerk role, and that the recording documents voluntary consent to the described procedure. Capture identity confirmation, an affirmative response, opportunity for questions, and confirmation questions were answered.
Keep documents and other records out of camera view. Keep the interaction continuous through the final response.
Do not stop and restart around a required answer.
Use the lane below for the clinic's state before the consent questions / final response.
Read the state-specific instruction at the point shown; do not combine the two lanes.
Do not explain clinical content or improvise wording.
Say: “California recording notice: this consent interaction is being recorded.”
Use the California statement only for California.
Capture confirmation that the clinician reviewed the procedure, material risks, benefits, and alternatives.
Capture confirmation that the participant received the Oregon consent form before recording began.
Capture the confirmation; do not explain or show forms.
State that the participant may stop the recording or ask for the clinician before answering.
Use the Oregon statement only for Oregon.
3  Playback check before you keep it
Set tablet playback to 68%. Stand 1.4 m (about four to five steps) from the tablet.

Return to 68% and the stated listening position.
First-listen the opening identity confirmation and a quieter consent answer.

Do not keep it. Correct the cause and record the entire interaction again.
Confirm every common and state-lane item is present, required faces stayed in frame, and recording ran continuously from opening through final response.
Do not repair a missing or failed element by editing, dubbing, or splicing.
4  Decide: keep, record again, or escalate
All setup, state-lane, continuous-recording, and first-listen checks pass.
Securely upload the complete recording using the approved tablet workflow.
Do not retain a recording that only sounds acceptable after raising volume.
A face is out of frame; any required state element is missing; any word is not understood first listen; or there is pumping, clipping, or room roar.
Correct the room/tablet/voice condition, then record the full interaction again from the opening.

sheets.name: Approval summary
rows: Two completed pilot periods | Distinct submitted Recording_ID values only | Publication remains pending Gabriel Calderon approval

First-review usability improved from 55.0% to 85.0% (+30.0 percentage points). The change is material. The largest source-supported driver was a reduction in Low voice / room roar failures from 7 to 1 distinct recordings. Remaining risk: 3 recordings in Period 2 were not usable on first review, so regional release should follow publication approval and the listed readiness actions.

Coverage convention: Cedar Station Clinic / Oregon / Period 2 had 0 submitted recordings; its site-period rate is N/A and it is excluded from any site-rate average. Overall and jurisdiction rates above use submitted recordings only.

sheets.name: Method & evidence
rows: Short disclosure of calculation choices used for the approval summary

Located the operational-export header by its Recording_ID label rather than its visible sheet position. Counted each submitted Recording_ID once. Exact overlapping rows agreed and did not increase numerators, denominators, failure counts, or jurisdiction totals.

Distinct submitted Recording_ID values with First-review disposition = “Usable on first review” ÷ all distinct submitted Recording_ID values in the same period and population. Period change = Period 2 rate − Period 1 rate, in percentage points.
Applied the same distinct-recording formula independently to California and Oregon. No cross-jurisdiction weighting or site-rate averaging was used.
Cedar Station Clinic / Oregon / Period 2 reported 0 submitted recordings in coverage. Its site-period rate is shown as N/A and excluded from any site-rate average; no success or failure was imputed.

Counted each distinct failed Recording_ID once under its failure classification. Materiality definition: absolute rate movement ≥9 percentage points OR a single failure category movement ≥6 distinct failed recordings.

Technical actions are based on validated Stonebridge observations. Ashcombe Energy's lapel-microphone and portrait-capture observation is comparative only and is not Stonebridge policy. State lanes reproduce the supplied Stonebridge counsel-reviewed operational summary.

criteria.description: 所需的 XLSX 成功打开，在面向职员的指南上打开，并且其填充区域呈现，没有剪切或不可读的核心指令。
criteria.evidence: 提交的工作簿结构、活动工作表和呈现的工作簿视图。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用 XLSX 阅读器打开确切提交的文件名并渲染填充区域。确认活动视图是操作职员指南，而不是计算、原始证据或方法注释。

original.criterion: The required XLSX opens successfully, opens on the clerk-facing guide, and its populated areas render without clipped or unreadable core instructions.
original.evidence: Submitted workbook structure, active worksheet, and rendered workbook views.
original.grader_hint: Open the exact submitted filename with an XLSX reader and render the populated areas. Confirm that the active view is the operational clerk guide rather than calculations, raw evidence, or a method note.

criteria.description: 面向职员的材料形成了从房间准备到录音、回放审查、处置和升级的连贯的首次使用序列，而不需要职员推断顺序。
criteria.evidence: 提交的工作簿中面向职员的指南。
criteria.grader_hint: 像新职员一样按顺序阅读指南。当轮班期间可以遵循序列而无需在无法解释的片段之间跳转或做出技术测序决定时，授予满分。

original.criterion: The clerk-facing material forms a coherent first-use sequence from room preparation through recording, playback review, disposition, and escalation, without requiring the clerk to infer the order.
original.evidence: Clerk-facing guide in the submitted workbook.
original.grader_hint: Read the guide in its presented order as a new clerk would. Award full credit when the sequence can be followed during a shift without jumping between unexplained fragments or making a technical sequencing decision.

criteria.description: 房间准备说明包括根据源验证证据中的要求确定的每个职员可操作的环境控制，并且不添加不受支持的控制。
criteria.evidence: 提交的设置说明与源验证观察结果进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 提取标记为必需或始终成功的验证结果，然后确认每个结果都已转化为实际的房间操作。明确描述为可选实验的建议不需要出现。

original.criterion: The room-preparation instructions include every clerk-actionable environmental control identified as required in the source validation evidence and do not add unsupported controls.
original.evidence: Submitted setup instructions compared with the source validation observations.
original.grader_hint: Extract the validation findings marked required or consistently successful, then confirm each is translated into a practical room action. Suggestions explicitly described as optional experiments need not appear.

criteria.description: 平板电脑方向、支撑、摄像头位置、麦克风间隙和拍摄距离说明与源中经过验证的操作范围一致。
criteria.evidence: 提交的设置指南和源技术验证证据。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每个物理设置指令与经过验证的配置和范围进行比较。等效的通俗语言描述，例如精确校准的身体长度比较，如果不扩大批准的范围，则是可以接受的。

original.criterion: The tablet orientation, support, camera position, microphone clearance, and subject-distance instructions agree with the validated operating range in the source.
original.evidence: Submitted setup guide and the source technical validation evidence.
original.grader_hint: Compare each physical setup instruction with the validated configuration and range. Equivalent plain-language descriptions, such as an accurately calibrated body-length comparison, are acceptable if they do not widen the approved range.

criteria.description: 该指南将有关平板电脑自动增益和低声语音的来源发现转换为准确、实用的口语指令，而不要求店员了解音频增益。
criteria.evidence: 提交的指南中的语音指导语言和源中的自动增益结果。
criteria.grader_hint: 满分需要关于口语水平的可行指导以及简单的结果或纠正。当信号源不支持时，拒绝鼓励窃窃私语、喊叫或手动增益控制的措辞。

original.criterion: The guide converts the source finding about tablet automatic gain and whispered speech into an accurate, practical speaking instruction without requiring the clerk to understand audio gain.
original.evidence: Voice-direction language in the submitted guide and automatic-gain findings in the source.
original.grader_hint: Full credit requires an actionable direction about speaking level and a simple consequence or correction. Reject wording that encourages whispering, shouting, or manual gain control when the source does not support it.

criteria.description: 播放自检使用源认可的平板电脑音量、收听位置、样本部分和首听清晰度标准。
criteria.evidence: 提交的工作簿和源验证协议中的播放说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认已验证的播放测试的所有操作元素均存在。职员必须能够在不使用分贝计或波形显示器的情况下重现支票。

original.criterion: The playback self-check uses the source-approved tablet volume, listening position, sample portions, and first-listen intelligibility standard.
original.evidence: Playback instructions in the submitted workbook and the source validation protocol.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that all operational elements of the validated playback test are present. A clerk must be able to reproduce the check without using a decibel meter or waveform display.

criteria.description: 每个源定义的强制重新记录条件都由明确的停止、纠正和重新记录指令表示。
criteria.evidence: 与源故障和升级标准相比，提交了自检和处置说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 从源头构建一组强制重新记录触发器，并将其与指南进行比较。如果没有失去其操作意义，类似的触发因素可以组合起来。

original.criterion: Every source-defined mandatory re-record condition is represented by a clear stop, correct, and record-again instruction.
original.evidence: Submitted self-check and disposition instructions compared with source failure and escalation criteria.
original.grader_hint: Build the set of mandatory re-record triggers from the source and compare it with the guide. Similar triggers may be combined if none lose their operative meaning.

criteria.description: 该指南将可纠正的技术故障与必须升级的问题区分开来，并且升级路线可供非工作时间的职员使用。
criteria.evidence: 指南中的异常处理和源中批准的升级信息。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查职员是否被告知哪些内容可以在本地重试，哪些内容不能即兴发挥，以及哪个来源列出的角色或渠道收到升级。

original.criterion: The guide distinguishes a correctable technical failure from an issue that must be escalated, and the escalation route is usable by an after-hours clerk.
original.evidence: Exception handling in the guide and approved escalation information in the source.
original.grader_hint: Check whether the clerk is told what can be retried locally, what must not be improvised, and which source-listed role or channel receives the escalation.

criteria.description: 加利福尼亚州的指示包括在律师审查的来源中标记为加利福尼亚州强制执行的所有同意记录元素，并排除标识为仅限俄勒冈州的元素。
criteria.evidence: 提交的指南的加利福尼亚部分和来源司法管辖区要求。
criteria.grader_hint: 将提交的加州指令与完整的加州强制性指令进行比较。如果指南明确将共享要求适用于加利福尼亚州，则可以一次性提出共享要求。

original.criterion: The California instructions include all consent-recording elements marked mandatory for California in the counsel-reviewed source and exclude elements identified as Oregon-only.
original.evidence: California portion of the submitted guide and the source jurisdiction requirements.
original.grader_hint: Compare the submitted California instructions with the complete California mandatory set. Shared requirements may be presented once if the guide clearly applies them to California.

criteria.description: 俄勒冈州的指示包括在律师审查的来源中标记为俄勒冈州强制执行的所有同意记录元素，并排除标识为仅限加利福尼亚州的元素。
criteria.evidence: 提交的指南的俄勒冈部分和来源管辖权要求。
criteria.grader_hint: 将提交的俄勒冈州指令与完整的俄勒冈州强制指令集进行比较。如果指南明确适用于俄勒冈州，则可以一次性提出共同要求。

original.criterion: The Oregon instructions include all consent-recording elements marked mandatory for Oregon in the counsel-reviewed source and exclude elements identified as California-only.
original.evidence: Oregon portion of the submitted guide and the source jurisdiction requirements.
original.grader_hint: Compare the submitted Oregon instructions with the complete Oregon mandatory set. Shared requirements may be presented once if the guide clearly applies them to Oregon.

criteria.description: 提出了共享和特定管辖区的要求，职员可以在记录期间识别适用的指令，而无需在心里协调两个政策列表。
criteria.evidence: 呈现的面向店员的指南。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估操作清晰度而不是特定布局。满分要求在工作流程中的相关点上明确区分共享的、仅限加利福尼亚州的和仅限俄勒冈州的操作。

original.criterion: Shared and jurisdiction-specific requirements are presented where a clerk can identify the applicable instruction during recording without mentally reconciling two policy lists.
original.evidence: Rendered clerk-facing guide.
original.grader_hint: Assess operational clarity rather than a particular layout. Full credit requires an unmistakable distinction between shared, California-only, and Oregon-only actions at the relevant point in the workflow.

criteria.description: 保持就绪的工作示例与源示例或完全受源支持的组合相匹配，并演示了可能保留的记录所需的所有检查。
criteria.evidence: 提交了积极的工作示例和来源验证或试点证据。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪示例中的每个设置、播放、管辖权和配置事实到来源。该示例必须以明确的“保持就绪”决策结束并解释原因。

original.criterion: The keep-ready worked example matches a source example or a fully source-supported combination and demonstrates all checks needed for a recording that may be retained.
original.evidence: Submitted positive worked example and source validation or pilot evidence.
original.grader_hint: Trace each setup, playback, jurisdiction, and disposition fact in the example to the source. The example must end with an unambiguous keep-ready decision and explain why.

criteria.description: 纠正工作示例使用源支持的故障，识别失败的检查，给出适当的纠正，并且需要重新记录而不是围绕缺陷进行编辑。
criteria.evidence: 提交了纠正示例和源故障证据。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认错误和更正得到来源的支持，并且该示例并不意味着合法的重大遗漏或听不见的响应可以通过修剪、配音或拼接来修复。

original.criterion: The correction worked example uses a source-supported failure, identifies the failed check, gives the appropriate correction, and requires a fresh recording rather than editing around the defect.
original.evidence: Submitted correction example and source failure evidence.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the failure and correction are supported by the source and that the example does not imply a legally material omission or inaudible response can be repaired by trimming, dubbing, or splicing.

criteria.description: 飞行员计数和比率使用每个源规定的记录键一次，因此重复或重叠的源行不会增加分子、分母、故障计数或管辖区总数。
criteria.evidence: 提交的试点计算和摘要与按源中所述键分组的源记录进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 独立地对源指定的唯一键上的试点记录进行重复数据删除，然后重新计算提交的指标。精确重复的行不得计算多次。

original.criterion: Pilot counts and rates use each source-stated recording key once, so duplicate or overlapping source rows do not increase a numerator, denominator, failure count, or jurisdiction total.
original.evidence: Submitted pilot calculations and summary compared with source records grouped by the key stated in the source.
original.grader_hint: Independently de-duplicate the pilot records on the source-stated unique key, then recalculate the submitted metrics. Exact duplicate rows must not be counted more than once.

criteria.description: 第一期总体初审可用率等于去重合格初审通过率除以相应的去重提交记录，±0.1个百分点以内。
criteria.evidence: 批准摘要和源试点记录中的第一期指标。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用工作簿中提供的 KPI 标签根据不同的记录键重新计算速率。以 ±0.1 个百分点的公差比较显示值。

original.criterion: The first-period overall first-review usable rate equals the de-duplicated qualifying first-review passes divided by the corresponding de-duplicated submitted recordings, within ±0.1 percentage points.
original.evidence: First-period metric in the approval summary and source pilot records.
original.grader_hint: Recompute the rate from distinct recording keys using the KPI labels supplied in the workbook. Compare the displayed value at a tolerance of ±0.1 percentage points.

criteria.description: 第二期总体初审可用率等于去重合格初审通过率除以相应的去重提交记录，±0.1个百分点以内。
criteria.evidence: 批准摘要和源试点记录中的第二期指标。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用工作簿中提供的 KPI 标签根据不同的记录键重新计算速率。以 ±0.1 个百分点的公差比较显示值。

original.grader_hint: Recompute the rate from distinct recording keys using the KPI labels supplied in the workbook. Compare the displayed value at a tolerance of ±0.1 percentage points.

criteria.description: 报告的首审可用率的周期变化等于第二期可用率减去第一期可用率，误差范围在±0.1个百分点内，且方向标记正确。
criteria.evidence: 批准摘要期间比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用两个时期独立重新计算的比率，用第二个时期减去第一个时期，并与规定的百分点变化进行比较。

original.criterion: The reported period-over-period change in first-review usable rate equals the second-period rate minus the first-period rate, within ±0.1 percentage points, with the direction labeled correctly.
original.evidence: Approval summary period comparison.
original.grader_hint: Use the independently recomputed rates for the two periods, subtract first from second, and compare with the stated percentage-point change.

criteria.description: 批准摘要中的加利福尼亚州和俄勒冈州时期指标等于根据每个司法管辖区的重复数据删除记录计算出的相应比率，误差在 ±0.1 个百分点之内。

original.criterion: The California and Oregon period metrics in the approval summary equal the corresponding rates calculated from de-duplicated records for each jurisdiction, within ±0.1 percentage points.
original.evidence: Jurisdiction comparison in the submitted workbook and source pilot records.
original.grader_hint: Recompute each displayed jurisdiction-period rate after de-duplication. Check every displayed value at ±0.1 percentage points and verify that records are assigned to the source-listed jurisdiction.

criteria.description: 任何具有零速率分母的站点周期都使用数学上合理的约定来表示，无论出现这种情况，都使用相同的约定，并且该约定在方法注释中进行了说明。
criteria.evidence: 现场周期计算、批准摘要和提交的方法说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 在源中找到零分母站点周期。接受明确披露的处理，例如在一致应用且不制造成功或失败记录时不适用或从速率比较中排除。不接受错误值或未公开的替代。

original.criterion: Any site-period with a zero rate denominator is represented using a mathematically defensible convention, the same convention is used wherever that case appears, and the convention is stated in the method note.
original.evidence: Site-period calculations, approval summary, and submitted method note.
original.grader_hint: Locate the zero-denominator site-period in the source. Accept a clearly disclosed treatment such as not applicable or exclusion from rate comparisons when it is applied consistently and does not fabricate successful or failed recordings. Do not accept an error value or an undisclosed substitution.

criteria.description: 重大变更标注包括满足源中提供的管理重要性定义的每个期间变更，并且不会在没有说明的操作原因的情况下将亚阈值变更标记为重大变更。
criteria.evidence: 批准摘要与源 KPI 定义和删除重复的试点结果进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 将源管理阈值应用于独立计算的周期变化。确认所有符合条件的变更均已标注，并且任何附加标注都有合理的、明确的理由。

original.criterion: The material-change callouts include every period change meeting the management materiality definition supplied in the source and do not label a sub-threshold change as material without a stated operational reason.
original.evidence: Approval summary compared with source KPI definitions and de-duplicated pilot results.
original.grader_hint: Apply the source management threshold to the independently computed period changes. Confirm that all qualifying changes are called out and that any additional callout has a defensible, stated reason.

criteria.description: 所陈述的重大期间变化的主要原因对应于去重复故障原因计数或份额的最大相关变化，而不是不受支持的因果推测。
criteria.evidence: 批准摘要解释和源飞行员故障分类。
criteria.grader_hint: 重复数据删除后按时期汇总失败原因，并将其变化与叙述进行比较。信用基于证据的归因，例如分布的改变；拒绝有关员工行为、设备缺陷或来源中未确立的法律合规性的主张。

original.criterion: The stated main causes of the material period changes correspond to the largest relevant changes in de-duplicated failure-reason counts or shares rather than unsupported causal speculation.
original.evidence: Approval-summary explanation and source pilot failure classifications.
original.grader_hint: Aggregate failure reasons by period after de-duplication and compare their changes with the narrative. Credit evidence-based attribution such as a changed distribution; reject claims about staff behavior, equipment defects, or legal compliance not established in the source.

criteria.description: 批准摘要给出了对这两个时期的决策有用的解释，包括哪些改进、哪些仍然存在风险以及推出的影响，而没有夸大证据。
criteria.evidence: 提交了批准摘要和基础来源结果。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估 Nadia Aubert 是否可以根据摘要做出批准或推出决定。它应该综合而不是仅仅重复一个度量表，并且必须区分观察和推理。

original.criterion: The approval summary gives a decision-useful interpretation of the two periods, including what improved, what remains at risk, and the rollout implication, without overstating the evidence.
original.evidence: Submitted approval summary and underlying source results.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether Nadia Aubert could make an approval or rollout decision from the summary. It should synthesize rather than merely repeat a metric table and must distinguish observation from inference.

criteria.description: 其余的推出操作使用源批准注释支持的所有者、依赖关系、优先级和时间安排，每个操作都足够具体以执行。
criteria.evidence: 提交的工作簿中的操作部分以及源部署或批准说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪操作所有者和时间来源。等效的日期措辞是可以接受的。完全的信用需要一个行动、负责任的所有者或角色，以及每个剩余的源列出的部署需求的可执行时间或依赖性。

original.criterion: Remaining rollout actions use the owners, dependencies, priorities, and timing supported by the source approval notes, with each action concrete enough to execute.
original.evidence: Action section in the submitted workbook and source rollout or approval notes.
original.grader_hint: Trace action owners and timing to the source. Equivalent date phrasing is acceptable. Full credit requires an action, accountable owner or role, and executable timing or dependency for each remaining source-listed rollout need.

criteria.description: 修订记录标识了对未完成的指南所做的重大更改，包括技术澄清、管辖权处理、自检标准和试点摘要添加，但未声明未经支持的批准。
criteria.evidence: 已提交的修订记录与源中未完成的指南和批准状态的比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 将源草稿与提交的出版版本进行比较。该记录可以对相关编辑进行分组，但必须让加布里埃尔·卡尔德隆了解实质性更改，并且不得声明已经批准，除非消息来源这么说。

original.criterion: The revision record identifies the material changes made from the unfinished guide, including technical clarification, jurisdiction handling, self-check criteria, and pilot-summary additions, without claiming unsupported approval.
original.evidence: Submitted revision record compared with the unfinished guide and approval status in the source.
original.grader_hint: Compare the source draft with the submitted publication version. The record may group related edits, but it must let Gabriel Calderon understand the substantive changes and must not state that approval has already occurred unless the source says so.

criteria.description: 交付的工作簿不包含可见或存储的 #REF!、#DIV/0! 或 #VALUE!已填充单元格中的错误值。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿公式、缓存值和渲染的填充范围。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有人口区域的公式和显示值。搜索 #REF!、#DIV/0! 和 #VALUE! 的单元格内容和缓存结果。

original.criterion: The delivered workbook contains no visible or stored #REF!, #DIV/0!, or #VALUE! error values in populated cells.
original.evidence: Workbook formulas, cached values, and rendered populated ranges.
original.grader_hint: Inspect formulas and displayed values across all populated areas. Search cell contents and cached results for #REF!, #DIV/0!, and #VALUE!.

criteria.description: 最终的工作簿可供两种受众专业使用：职员收到简洁、清晰的操作指示，而批准和方法材料仍然可用，而不会中断记录工作流程。
criteria.evidence: 整体渲染的工作簿。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查导航、视觉层次结构、密度、标签以及操作与批准材料的分离。如果第一夜的职员很难找到或执行技术上正确的内容，则不应获得完全的认可。

original.criterion: The final workbook is professionally usable by both audiences: clerks receive concise, legible operational directions, while the approval and method material remains available without interrupting the recording workflow.
original.evidence: Rendered workbook as a whole.
original.grader_hint: Review navigation, visual hierarchy, density, labeling, and separation of operational versus approval material. Technically correct content should not receive full credit if a first-night clerk would struggle to find or execute it.

spec.professional_context: Stonebridge Agricultural is preparing a tablet-based consent-video process for occupational-health clinics in California and Oregon. The completed workbook will be used by inexperienced clinic clerks and reviewed by senior leaders before regional publication.
difficulty_sources: Translating technical audio validation into accurate actions for nontechnical clinic clerks
Reconciling overlapping pilot records on the source-stated recording key
Selecting and disclosing a defensible zero-denominator convention
Computing and explaining two-period and cross-jurisdiction performance changes
Separating shared, California-specific, and Oregon-specific recording requirements
Combining a clerk-facing workflow with a decision-ready approval summary in one workbook

semantic_contents: An unfinished Stonebridge Agricultural clerk guide with approved tone, branding cues, audience description, incomplete setup language, placeholders for playback checks, and an uncompleted revision record.

Complete pilot-event evidence for two named rollout periods across California and Oregon, with organization, clinic, jurisdiction, recording key, submission status, first-review disposition, re-record outcome, failure reason, setup duration, and source-supported operational fields.
Coverage records that enumerate participating clinic-period combinations, including one clinic-period with no submitted recordings and therefore a zero rate denominator.
AV validation observations produced jointly by Stonebridge Agricultural and Ashcombe Energy, clearly distinguishing validated Stonebridge operating requirements from comparative Ashcombe practices.
Counsel-reviewed California and Oregon recording requirements, with shared requirements and jurisdiction-only requirements explicitly identifiable.
Management reporting definitions, a materiality threshold, rollout responsibilities, approval status, and timing information that would ordinarily accompany an internal publication package.
Two labeled source examples: one passing configuration and one failed configuration that becomes acceptable only after correction and a complete fresh recording.

layout_defects.banner_and_gutters: Place the operational pilot table below a prominent banner block and to the right of blank or administrative gutter columns so that the true headers do not begin at A1. The banner must provide ordinary report context and must not conceal a second competing table.
layout_defects.duplicate_overlap: Repeat several pilot records as exact or semantically identical overlaps. The source itself states that Recording_ID is the unique recording key. Duplicate copies must agree on all substantive fields so the inputs remain mutually consistent, and no precedence rule is needed.
layout_defects.zero_denominator: Include one valid clinic-period coverage record with zero submitted recordings. Supply no convention for displaying or aggregating its rate, forcing the worker to choose and disclose a defensible treatment.

absence_of_other_defects: Do not include missing required values in non-zero-denominator records.
Do not include contradictory versions of a recording key.

Do not include formula errors, broken links, hidden graded rows, unit inconsistencies, floating-point noise traps, side-by-side unrelated tables, stale totals, ambiguous date formats, or image-only graded facts.
Do not seed exclusions, unsupported blank-field traps, or residual spreadsheet errors.
All graded facts must remain text-extractable.

validated_setup: Use the tablet in landscape orientation on a stable support at approximately eye level.
Keep the tablet microphone unobstructed and disable or remove any source-listed accessory shown to interfere with capture.
Maintain a validated patient-to-tablet distance range of 58 to 82 centimeters.
Position the subject to avoid the source-listed backlight condition and keep required faces within the validated frame.
Apply all source-listed actionable room controls, including the approved treatment of doors, avoidable equipment noise, and paper handling.
technical_truth.voice_and_auto_gain: Validation must show that whispered answers cause automatic gain to raise room sound and reduce intelligibility. The reliable direction is a normal conversational voice at the validated distance, with no unsupported instruction to adjust gain manually.
technical_truth.playback_test: Provide a clerk-reproducible test using a tablet playback level of 68 percent, a listening position 1.4 meters from the device, and source-designated samples from the opening identification and a quieter consent answer. Passing requires every word to be understood on the first listen without raising playback to maximum and without source-defined pumping, clipping, or room-roar symptoms.
technical_truth.meter_evidence: The technical evidence may include measured operating ranges for validation, but the finished clerk test must not depend on a dBFS meter, waveform, external microphone, or specialist application.
technical_truth.re_record_logic: Source facts must distinguish mandatory fresh-recording triggers from correctable setup issues and from escalation-only issues. Editing, dubbing, or splicing around a failed consent element is never an approved correction.
technical_truth.worked_examples: One source example satisfies setup, jurisdiction, content, and playback checks. A second fails a specific validated condition, documents the practical correction, and passes only after a complete new recording.

jurisdiction_truth.requirements: Create a counsel-reviewed internal summary with a common baseline plus clearly different California-only and Oregon-only recording elements. The differences must affect what the clerk says, captures, or confirms during the workflow rather than being decorative metadata.
jurisdiction_truth.scope_control: Label the material as Stonebridge Agricultural's approved operational requirements. Ashcombe Energy observations may support technical validation but must not be presented as Stonebridge policy or jurisdictional authority.

pilot_model.key: Recording_ID is stated in the source as the unique key for a submitted recording.
pilot_model.periods: Use two completed, clearly named periods with all event dates falling unambiguously into one period.
pilot_model.first_review_rate: For each applicable population, divide the number of distinct submitted Recording_ID values with the source-defined first-review usable disposition by the number of distinct submitted Recording_ID values in that population.
pilot_model.period_change: Compute percentage-point change as second-period first-review usable rate minus first-period first-review usable rate.
pilot_model.jurisdiction_rates: Apply the same de-duplicated rate formula independently to California and Oregon in each period.
pilot_model.zero_denominator: The zero-submission clinic-period has no mathematically defined rate. The gold presentation uses not applicable and excludes it from averages of site-level rates, while grading also accepts another defensible, consistently disclosed treatment that does not invent success or failure.
pilot_model.failure_analysis: Count each distinct Recording_ID once under its source failure classification. Determine the main change drivers from the largest relevant period changes in failure counts or shares.
pilot_model.materiality: Include an ordinary management reporting note defining a material change as an absolute movement of at least 9 percentage points or a change of at least 6 distinct failed recordings in a single failure category. The reference script applies this definition after de-duplication.
data_generation_constraints: Choose event values so both periods and both jurisdictions have non-zero overall denominators.
Ensure at least one overall improvement meets materiality while at least one operational risk remains visible.
Ensure the leading failure-reason change genuinely explains a material portion of the overall movement.
Keep all arithmetic derivable directly from the supplied records.

publication_and_actions.revision_record: The source draft and approval notes must make it possible to document additions or clarifications to setup, voice guidance, playback criteria, jurisdiction handling, worked examples, calculations, and escalation without implying final approval.
publication_and_actions.owners: Use only the allowed people. Assign Nadia Aubert as the senior decision recipient, Gabriel Calderon as publication approver, and suitable source-supported operational responsibilities to Magda Danforth, Ilse Tanaka, and Aurelio Mikkelsen.
publication_and_actions.actions: Provide source-supported rollout actions with owners, dependencies or priorities, and concrete dates or relative timing. Actions must be sufficient for an executable approval summary without requiring outside facts.
publication_and_actions.privacy: Use synthetic recording identifiers and clinic labels only. Include no patient names, dates of birth, images, voices, medical record numbers, addresses, or clinical details.

script_steps: Locate the pilot headers by content rather than assuming A1.
Read all populated pilot records and normalize only superficial whitespace.
De-duplicate by Recording_ID while confirming overlapping copies agree.
Calculate overall and jurisdiction-period first-review usable rates from distinct submitted keys.
Represent the zero-denominator clinic-period as not applicable in the reference solution and document its exclusion from site-rate averaging.
Aggregate failure reasons by distinct recording key and apply the source materiality definition.
Extract the complete required technical, jurisdictional, escalation, action, and revision fact sets for rubric comparison.
Scan the reference solution for spreadsheet error values and render all populated areas for usability review.
gold_derivation.intended_verdict: A passing solution is a publication-ready workbook that an inexperienced clerk can execute accurately, gives senior leadership a source-grounded two-period comparison, handles duplicate and zero-denominator evidence transparently, and does not invent policy, patient information, or unsupported causes.

original_instruction:
You are the regional audio and video technician supporting Stonebridge Agricultural’s occupational-health clinics. The clinics are moving to self-recorded pre-procedure consent videos made by clerks on network tablets, with no AV specialist present after hours, and Nadia Aubert needs a guide that a clerk with no recording background can use correctly on the first night. Magda Danforth has assembled `clinic_consent_recording_pack.xlsx`, which contains the unfinished clerk guide, the two-period clinic pilot results, technical validation observations from Stonebridge Agricultural and Ashcombe Energy, and the counsel-reviewed requirements for California and Oregon. Turn that material into one publication-ready workbook named `Stonebridge_clerk_recording_guide.xlsx`. It should open on a plain-language, clerk-facing sequence covering room and tablet setup, the recording itself, playback checks, and clear reasons to stop and record again. Translate the technical findings into actions a clerk can perform without meters or specialist terminology, but do not simplify them in a way that permits an unusable consent recording. Include worked examples showing both a recording that is ready to keep and one that must be corrected, and make the California and Oregon requirements easy to distinguish at the point where the clerk needs them. Add a concise approval summary for Nadia comparing the two pilot periods, identifying the material changes and their main causes, and giving concrete owners and timing for the remaining rollout actions. The calculations must reflect the source records rather than the apparent spreadsheet footprint, and any judgment calls that affect the reported rates should be visible in a short method note. Record what you changed from the unfinished guide so Gabriel Calderon can approve the publication version without comparing every cell. Keep patient information out of the workbook, do not present Ashcombe Energy’s practices as Stonebridge policy, and use only facts supported by the supplied material. Write the completed file into the top level of the working directory using exactly the filename `Stonebridge_clerk_recording_guide.xlsx`.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/clinic_consent_recording_pack.xlsx` — Provides the unfinished guide, two-period pilot records, AV validation findings, approved California and Oregon requirements, rollout responsibilities, and publication context.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `Stonebridge_clerk_recording_guide.xlsx` — Publication-ready clerk recording and self-check guide with worked examples, jurisdiction-specific instructions, pilot-period comparison, method disclosure, rollout actions, and revision record. (Place the workbook at the top level of the working directory.; Use the exact filename Stonebridge_clerk_recording_guide.xlsx.; The workbook must open on the clerk-facing guide.; Use only facts supported by clinic_consent_recording_pack.xlsx.; Do not include patient information or characterize Ashcombe Energy practices as Stonebridge Agricultural policy.; Make calculation judgment calls visible in a concise method note.; Include a record of changes made from the unfinished guide.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.

translation.literal_protection: Filenames, URLs, identifiers and Arabic-number tokens protected before translation and exact multiplicity verified. Materials, gold previews, original rubric objects and original audit records kept unchanged.
translation.original_files: English originals; materials and reference deliverables not translated.
